title: Indicating and Recording — Flight Data Recorder — Install the Isolated Mounting Tray and Load the Extended Frame
abstract: Retrofit of the extended recording frame and the isolated recorder mounting tray, required for compliance with the revised operational recording rule and to remove the cruise built-in test warnings.

sections.planning_reason: The revised operational recording requirement adds fourteen parameters that the delivered frame cannot hold, and the compliance date applies to the whole fleet regardless of delivery standard. Four operators separately reported recorder built-in test warnings in cruise that cleared on descent, traced to the delivered mounting tray amplifying the local structural response. Doing both in one visit avoids opening the avionics bay twice.
sections.description: This bulletin replaces the recorder mounting tray with the isolated variant, re-clips the recorder harness clear of the isolator travel with cushioned loop clamps, and loads the extended recording frame. The recorder unit itself is retained and refitted to the new tray. The cockpit voice recorder installation is not affected.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the avionics bay and remove electrical power from the recorder. Do the recorder removal in AMM-M-31-30-11-000-035-A and put the unit in a protected position. Remove the delivered mounting tray, install the isolated tray on the existing rack holes and torque the four isolators in the sequence given in the bulletin. Refit the recorder, re-clip the harness with the supplied cushioned loop clamps so that fifteen millimetres of free travel remains at each isolator, and reconnect. Restore power, load the extended frame with the portable loader and confirm the reported frame identification. Do a recorder readout of five minutes of data and verify the new parameters are present. Close the bay and make the records entry.
sections.effectivity_note: Applies to all MERIDIAN Family aircraft delivered before MSN M00412. Aircraft delivered from that MSN carry the post modification standard and require the frame reload only if their recording configuration has been changed since delivery.
sections.material_note: Kit contains the isolated mounting tray, four isolators, the cushioned loop clamp set and the earthing strap. The extended frame is supplied electronically. The removed tray is returned for credit within ninety days.

type_data.compliance_time: Before 1 January 2026, in accordance with the operational recording requirement.
